title: Address confirmation
failed: Could not reach the server to confirm your address. Check your connection and try again.

used.title: This link has already been used
used.body: Your address is already confirmed, so there is nothing more to do here.

expired.title: This link has expired
expired.bodySignedIn: A link works for 24 hours. Ask for a new letter below.
expired.bodySignedOut: A link works for 24 hours. Sign in, and ask for a new letter from the banner at the top of the screen.

banner.title: Confirm your e-mail address
banner.body: We sent a link to {{email}}. Until you follow it you can look around, but not create Alerts.

resend.sent: Sent. A letter can take a minute or two — look in the spam folder too.
resend.limited_one: You have asked for several letters in a short time. Try again in {{count, number}} minute.
resend.limited_other: You have asked for several letters in a short time. Try again in {{count, number}} minutes.
resend.limitedSoon: You have asked for several letters in a short time. Try again in a few minutes.
resend.failed: Could not send the letter. Try again in a moment.
